description: Security, evaluation, and observability: input/output validation, prompt-injection defenses, the guardrail interface (local simulated default, import-guarded Bedrock adapter), the tracing interface (local default, noop, gated LangSmith), and the offline LLM-as-judge. Depends on FEAT-002 (gateway, state). Ordered before the API feature that wires these at the request boundary.
steps: Create app/security/validation.py: input rules (topic required str, trimmed length 1-2000, non-whitespace, control chars stripped, one topic per request; session_id optional ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$; output_format in {markdown, json, pdf} default markdown) returning 422-mapped errors; output validation = non-empty report plus the hard gate that every claim source_id exists in produced sources (violation -> 500); a narrow secret denylist that REPLACES (never deletes) any substring equal to a configured live secret value or matching sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,} with the literal [REDACTED], a no-op on the default offline path.

Create app/security/injection.py: a documented pattern set (ignore previous instructions, you are now, system-prompt override markers, tool-exfiltration phrasing) scanned on user input and any retrieved/external content; each matched span replaced in place with the literal [neutralized-injection]; the whole scanned blob wrapped as <untrusted>\n{sanitized}\n</untrusted> before any agent sees it; record an event {type: injection_neutralized, count, boundary} without logging the match text.

Create app/security/guardrail_base.py (Guardrail Protocol check(text, boundary) -> GuardrailDecision{allowed, reasons}), guardrail_local.py (LocalGuardrail default: enforces the documented local policy blocking the labeled unsafe/injection set, runs at both input and output boundaries), guardrail_bedrock.py (BedrockGuardrail: import-guarded boto3; check calls apply_guardrail with guardrailIdentifier/guardrailVersion/source=INPUT|OUTPUT/content=[{text:{text}}]; maps allowed = response['action'] != 'GUARDRAIL_INTERVENED' and reasons = [cat for a in response.get('assessments', []) for cat in a.keys()]; network/credential error falls back to LocalGuardrail), factory.py.

Create app/eval/tracing_base.py (Tracer Protocol start_run/record_event/end_run), tracing_local.py (LocalTracer default: accumulates an in-memory run trace emitted via structured logging capturing agent order, provider/mode per call, retry/fallback events, terminal outcome, secret-redacted), tracing_noop.py (NoopTracer), tracing_langsmith.py (LangSmithTracer, gated), and eval/factory.py selecting by settings.

Create app/eval/judge.py: LLM-as-judge producing relevance, faithfulness, groundedness, completeness, coherence in [0,1], computed deterministically from the shared containment(text, reference) metric (faithfulness/groundedness = mean containment of each claim against its best resolving source snippet; completeness = fraction of knowledge points referenced by at least one claim; relevance = mean containment of claims against query tokens passed as reference; coherence = fraction of non-empty Markdown sections capped at 1.0). Offline via the mock gateway.

Create tests/unit/test_validation.py, tests/unit/test_injection.py, tests/unit/test_guardrail.py, tests/unit/test_tracing.py, tests/eval/__init__.py, tests/eval/test_judge.py covering the acceptance criteria; the Bedrock adapter is boundary-tested with the live boto3 client mocked to the documented apply_guardrail response shape.
acceptance_criteria: A known prompt-injection pattern is neutralized to the exact [neutralized-injection] marker and wrapped in <untrusted>...</untrusted>; the event is recorded without logging the match text

The local guardrail blocks the labeled unsafe set at both input and output boundaries; the Bedrock adapter maps the mocked apply_guardrail response to allowed/reasons without KeyError and falls back to local on error

Input validation enforces the documented limits; output validation fails a claim whose source_id is absent from produced sources; the secret denylist replaces matches with [REDACTED] and is a no-op offline
The local tracer captures agent order, provider/mode per call, retry/fallback events, and terminal outcome with no secret values
The judge produces five numeric scores in [0,1] offline using the mock gateway
uv run mypy app/security app/eval reports no errors
No file created in this feature contains a comment or docstring
verification: uv run pytest tests/unit/test_validation.py tests/unit/test_injection.py tests/unit/test_guardrail.py tests/unit/test_tracing.py tests/eval/test_judge.py
findings: Implemented app/security/{validation,injection,guardrail_base,guardrail_local,guardrail_bedrock,factory}.py and app/eval/{tracing_base,tracing_local,tracing_noop,tracing_langsmith,judge,factory}.py plus tests. No version bumps. Interface contracts the API feature (FEAT-005) must wire: validation.validate_input(topic, session_id, output_format) raises InputValidationError{field,message} -> map to 422; validate_output(report, claims, sources) and validate_attribution_integrity raise OutputIntegrityError -> map to 500; redact_secrets(report, live_secrets) applies the sk-/live-value denylist and is a no-op when live_secrets is empty. injection.scan(text, boundary) returns InjectionScan{sanitized, wrapped, count, boundary}; use .wrapped before any agent sees content and record injection.injection_event(scan) in the trace. security.factory.build_guardrail(settings) returns a Guardrail with check(text, boundary)->GuardrailDecision{allowed, reasons}; run at BOTH input and output boundaries, and per carry-forward run the OUTPUT guardrail BEFORE validate_output/attribution integrity. eval.factory.build_tracer(settings) returns a Tracer (start_run/record_event/end_run); LocalTracer.events/outcome are readable. eval.judge.Judge(gateway).score(query, draft, claims, sources, knowledge) is async and returns {relevance, faithfulness, groundedness, completeness, coherence} in [0,1]; call only when evaluate=true and populate ResearchResult.scores. BedrockGuardrail/LangSmithTracer accept an injected client for boundary tests and are import-guarded (boto3/langsmith only imported when selected); both fall back to Local on error. Verification passed: pytest (25 feature tests, full suite 74 passed), mypy app/security app/eval clean, ruff check + ruff format --check clean. No comments/docstrings in any created file.
